claim.claim-text: 1. A computer implemented method for operating on a target function to provide computer code instructions configured to implement the target function, the method comprising
2. The method according to claim 1 wherein the computer code instructions a produced as a stream.
3. The method according to any preceding claim wherein the computer code instructions are produced one node at a time.

4. The method according to any preceding claim wherein the instructions are written in computer code configured to be executed directly by a CPU, optionally wherein the computer code is binary object code.
5. The method according to any preceding claim wherein determining a linearized computational map (100) comprises a single evaluation of the target function.
6. The method according to any preceding claim wherein the instructions are configured to process independent instances of vectorised input data using native CPU vectorisation.
7. The method according to any preceding claim wherein forming the instructions for the each node is performed prior to performing said steps for a subsequent node of the LCM (100).
8. The method according to any preceding claim wherein the instructions comprise memory to register allocation instructions.
9. The method according to claim 8 further comprising forming an auxiliary data structure to define a memory to register allocation.
10. The method according to any preceding claim wherein the computer code instructions are written sequentially in memory.

11. The method according to any preceding claim, wherein the method comprises, for each node of the LCM (100), forming computer code instructions by providing overloaded operators for the elementary operations wherein the output of the overloaded operators enacted on an active data type variable comprises computer code instructions configured to:

(i) compute intermediate data associated with a forward function of an automatic adjoint differentiation algorithm; and, (ii) increment, according to the automatic adjoint differentiation algorithm, adjoint variables of the preceding connected nodes of the each node in dependence on intermediate data.

12. The method of claim 11, wherein forming computer code instructions for both step (i) and step (ii) for each node is performed prior to performing said steps for a subsequent node of the LCM (100) so that the computer code instructions are produced as a stream one node at a time with the instructions for the forward and reverse functions of the automatic adjoint algorithm created in parallel.

13. The method according to claim 11 or 12, wherein either the instructions of step (i) are written sequentially from beginning to end, and/or the instructions of step (ii) are written sequentially from end to beginning.
14. The method according to claim 13 wherein the completed sets of instructions formed according to step (i) and step (ii) are concatenated.
15. A computer program product comprising program instructions configured to program a processor to perform the method of any preceding claim.
